subject: Inquiry regarding extracting results for each observation point.

messages.author: 14acf3cf1ba1a268
messages.subject: Inquiry regarding extracting results for each observation point.
parts: "Hello everyone. Currently, I am conducting a hydrological simulation (using ArcSWAT) using the R-SWAT without UI version. As you can see from my previous post, I am using streamflow data collected from three observation points. So far, after the completion of the simulation (1000 iterations, 34 selected parameters), I would like to extract the PPU, sensitivity parameters, and the best simulation results for each observation point to compare them with the observed values. However, I haven't been able to figure out how to extract these data from the results for each specific point. If you have any ideas or methods that could help me with my problem, it would be greatly appreciated and would contribute significantly to my research. I look forward to your response. Thank you."
